hints.title: Neighbor Comparison Condition
hints.text: Traverse the array from index 1 to n - 2 and inspect whether each element is strictly greater or strictly less than both its left and right neighbors.

hints.title: Accumulation Counters
hints.text: Maintain separate running sums for peak values and valley values.

hints.title: Linear Single Pass
hints.text: A single linear pass across the interior elements computes the exact difference without auxiliary structures.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Higher order passes are redundant as each element needs only immediate adjacent neighbor checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary memory using scalar accumulators.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly handles boundary conditions by excluding index 0 and index n - 1.
